mapper.sql: select deployment_id, site_id, request_version, config_version, repo_owner, repo_name, branch, publish_dir, commit_sha, trigger_type, status, release_id, previous_release_id, attempt_count, next_attempt_time, error_code, error_message, log_text, file_count, total_bytes, release_available, finished_time, create_time, update_time from qt_page_deployment
mapper.insert: insert into qt_page_deployment ( site_id, request_version, config_version, repo_owner, repo_name, branch, publish_dir, commit_sha, trigger_type, status, release_id, previous_release_id, attempt_count, next_attempt_time, error_code, error_message, log_text, file_count, total_bytes, release_available, finished_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{siteId}, #{requestVersion}, #{configVersion}, #{repoOwner}, #{repoName}, #{branch}, #{publishDir}, #{commitSha}, #{triggerType}, #{status}, #{releaseId}, #{previousReleaseId}, #{attemptCount}, #{nextAttemptTime}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{logText}, #{fileCount}, #{totalBytes}, #{releaseAvailable}, #{finishedTime}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: where site_id = #{siteId} and trigger_type = 'MANUAL' and status = 'PENDING' and repo_owner = (select repo_owner from qt_page_site where site_id = #{siteId}) and repo_name = (select repo_name from qt_page_site where site_id = #{siteId}) and branch = (select branch from qt_page_site where site_id = #{siteId}) and publish_dir = (select publish_dir from qt_page_site where site_id = #{siteId}) order by deployment_id desc limit 1
where site_id = #{siteId} order by request_version desc, deployment_id desc
where status = 'PENDING' and (next_attempt_time is null or next_attempt_time <= #{now}) order by deployment_id limit #{limit}
where status in ('RESOLVING', 'DOWNLOADING', 'VALIDATING') order by deployment_id

where site_id = #{siteId} and commit_sha is null and status in ('PENDING', 'RESOLVING', 'DOWNLOADING', 'VALIDATING') and repo_owner = (select repo_owner from qt_page_site where site_id = #{siteId}) and repo_name = (select repo_name from qt_page_site where site_id = #{siteId}) and branch = (select branch from qt_page_site where site_id = #{siteId}) and publish_dir = (select publish_dir from qt_page_site where site_id = #{siteId}) order by deployment_id desc limit 1
where site_id = #{siteId} and trigger_type = 'ROLLBACK' and status in ('PENDING', 'RESOLVING', 'DOWNLOADING', 'VALIDATING', 'PUBLISHING') order by deployment_id desc limit 1

select distinct release_id from ( select release_id from qt_page_deployment where site_id = #{siteId} and release_id is not null and status in ('PENDING', 'RESOLVING', 'DOWNLOADING', 'VALIDATING', 'PUBLISHING') union all select release_id from ( select release_id from qt_page_deployment where site_id = #{siteId} and release_id is not null and status = 'SUCCESS' and release_available = 1 order by request_version desc, deployment_id desc limit 5 ) recent_success ) protected_ids
mapper.update: update qt_page_deployment set release_available = 0 where site_id = #{siteId} and release_id = #{releaseId}
